notes: Sanctum of All. Printed: 'If an ability of another Shrine you control triggers while you control six or more Shrines, that ability triggers an additional time.' Five is not six: seat 0 controls five Shrines (Sanctum of All, Sanctum of Stone Fangs and three plain ones), so Stone Fangs triggers once on turn 3's first main phase with X = 5: seat 0 gains 5 (25), seat 1 loses 5 (15).
